$comment: Supported document types: the fields the AI fills and the generated cover page shows. Read by backend (chat) and frontend (build time). Field labels double as the template term names they resolve (see `refs` for aliases). Each party role adds <role>.company/.name/.title/.noticeAddress fields.

effectiveDate.label: Effective Date
effectiveDate.description: The date the agreement takes effect.

orderDate.label: Order Date
orderDate.description: The date of the Order Form.

subscriptionPeriod.label: Subscription Period
subscriptionPeriod.description: Length of the subscription, e.g. '12 months'.

nonRenewalNoticeDate.label: Non-Renewal Notice Date
nonRenewalNoticeDate.description: How far before renewal a party must give notice not to renew, e.g. '30 days before the end of the Subscription Period'.

generalCapAmount.label: General Cap Amount
generalCapAmount.description: Cap on each party's liability, e.g. 'the fees paid or payable in the 12 months before the claim'.

increasedClaims.label: Increased Claims
increasedClaims.description: Claims subject to the higher Increased Cap Amount, if any.

increasedCapAmount.label: Increased Cap Amount
increasedCapAmount.description: Higher liability cap for Increased Claims, if any.

unlimitedClaims.label: Unlimited Claims
unlimitedClaims.description: Claims with no liability cap, if any.

providerCoveredClaims.label: Provider Covered Claims
providerCoveredClaims.description: Claims the Provider will defend and indemnify against, beyond the standard ones.

customerCoveredClaims.label: Customer Covered Claims
customerCoveredClaims.description: Claims the Customer will defend and indemnify against.

additionalWarranties.label: Additional Warranties
additionalWarranties.description: Warranties beyond the Standard Terms, if any.

dpa.label: DPA
dpa.description: The Data Processing Agreement that applies, if any.

securityPolicy.label: Security Policy
securityPolicy.description: The security policy or measures that apply.

governingLaw.label: Governing Law
governingLaw.description: The jurisdiction whose law governs, e.g. 'Delaware'.

chosenCourts.label: Chosen Courts
chosenCourts.description: Courts with exclusive jurisdiction, e.g. 'the state and federal courts in New Castle County, Delaware'.

documents.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
documents.description: Two parties share confidential information with each other, e.g. to evaluate a business relationship.

fields.label: Party 1 notice address
fields.description: Email or postal address for legal notices.

fields.label: Party 2 notice address
fields.description: Email or postal address for legal notices.

fields.label: Purpose
fields.description: How Confidential Information may be used.

fields.label: MNDA Term type
fields.description: 'expires' after mndaTermYears, or continues 'until-terminated'.

fields.label: MNDA Term years
fields.description: 1-99; used when the MNDA term expires.

fields.label: Term of Confidentiality type
fields.description: Protected for confidentialityYears ('years'), or in 'perpetuity'.

fields.label: Term of Confidentiality years
fields.description: 1-99; used when confidentiality lasts a number of years.

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.description: A US state, e.g. 'Delaware'.

fields.label: Jurisdiction
fields.description: Courts with jurisdiction, e.g. 'courts located in New Castle, DE'.

fields.label: MNDA Modifications
fields.description: Changes to the Standard Terms; empty for none.

documents.name: Cloud Service Agreement
documents.description: A Provider sells SaaS or another cloud service to a Customer on a subscription.

fields.label: Technical Support
fields.description: Support the Provider offers, e.g. 'email support on business days'.

documents.name: Software License Agreement
documents.description: A Provider licenses on-premise or downloadable software to a Customer.

fields.label: Permitted Uses
fields.description: What the Customer may use the software for.

fields.label: License Limits
fields.description: Limits on use, e.g. number of users or installations.

fields.label: Payment Process
fields.description: How and when fees are invoiced and paid.

fields.label: Deletion Procedure
fields.description: How the Customer removes the software when the license ends.

fields.label: Warranty Period
fields.description: How long the software warranty lasts, e.g. '90 days'.

documents.name: Service Level Agreement
documents.description: Uptime and support response commitments, with service credits, for a cloud service.

fields.label: Target Uptime
fields.description: Monthly availability target, e.g. '99.9%'.

fields.label: Target Response Time
fields.description: Support response target, e.g. '4 business hours'.

fields.label: Support Channel
fields.description: Where support requests go, e.g. 'support@provider.com'.

fields.label: Uptime Credit
fields.description: Credit when uptime is missed, e.g. '10% of monthly fees'.

fields.label: Response Time Credit
fields.description: Credit when response times are missed.

fields.label: Scheduled Downtime
fields.description: Maintenance windows excluded from uptime.

documents.name: Data Processing Agreement
documents.description: Terms for a Provider processing personal data on a Customer's behalf (GDPR and similar laws).

fields.label: Agreement
fields.description: The main agreement this DPA supplements, e.g. 'Cloud Service Agreement dated 1 January 2026'.

fields.label: Special Category Data
fields.description: Sensitive data (health, biometrics, ...) processed, if any.

fields.label: Special Category Data Restrictions or Safeguards
Frequency of Transfer
fields.description: e.g. 'continuous'.

fields.label: Duration of Processing
fields.description: e.g. 'for the term of the Agreement'.

fields.label: Governing Member State
fields.description: EU member state for the Standard Contractual Clauses, e.g. 'Ireland'.

fields.label: Provider Security Contact
fields.description: Who to contact about security incidents.

documents.name: Business Associate Agreement
documents.description: HIPAA terms for a Provider handling protected health information for a covered Company.

fields.label: Agreement
fields.description: The main agreement this BAA supplements.

fields.label: Breach Notification Period
fields.description: How quickly a breach must be reported, e.g. '30 days'.

fields.label: Limitations
fields.description: Limits on how the Provider may use or disclose PHI, if any.

documents.name: AI Addendum
documents.description: Adds terms for AI features: whether customer data may be used for training, and how AI inputs and outputs are treated.

fields.label: Training Data
fields.description: Customer data the Provider may use for training, or 'None'.

fields.label: Training Purposes
fields.description: What training is allowed for, e.g. 'improving the Provider's models for all customers'.

documents.name: Professional Services Agreement
documents.description: A Provider performs services (consulting, implementation, ...) for a Customer under statements of work.

fields.label: SOW Term
fields.description: How long the statement of work lasts.

fields.label: Payment Period
fields.description: e.g. 'within 30 days of invoice'.

fields.label: Rejection Period
fields.description: Time the Customer has to reject a deliverable.

fields.label: Time of Assignment
fields.description: When deliverable IP passes to the Customer, e.g. 'upon payment'.

documents.name: Pilot Agreement
documents.description: A Customer trials a Provider's product for a limited pilot period.

fields.label: Pilot Period
fields.description: e.g. '90 days from the Effective Date'.

documents.name: Design Partner Agreement
documents.description: Early product access for a Partner in exchange for feedback.

fields.label: Term
fields.description: How long the program lasts.

fields.label: Program
fields.description: What the design partner program involves.

fields.label: Fees
fields.description: Fees, or 'None'.

documents.name: Partnership Agreement
documents.description: A Company and a Partner collaborate, e.g. reselling, referrals or co-marketing.

fields.label: Obligations
fields.description: What each party will do.
